headline: 27 active wildfires are burning uncontained in the US today. The most serious is the Three Queens Fire in WA, threatening 191 structures.

active_threats.name: Three Queens
active_threats.narrative: The Three Queens Fire in Kittitas County, WA has burned 9,583 acres and is 95% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **191 structures threatened**. 1 personnel are assigned. Winds are expected to stay comparatively light over the next 24 hours (gusts near 31 mph), which should limit further wind-driven spread for now. This is a sustained, terrain-channeled wind regime — the setup our WindNinja terrain downscaling is built to resolve. Forecast wind (SE) is not currently aligned toward Easton CDP, the nearest community of size, 13 miles away.
